description.narrative: The objectives of the Phase-XIV of the ISP will be to (a) Continue effective implementation of ODS phase-out activities, sustaining the ODS phase-out, (b) coordinate actions to allow the completion implementation of HPMP Stage-II and smooth transition towards full implementation of the Stage-III, including supporting the institutional matters required to enact and enforce the ban on HCFC-22 in manufacturing of new Refrigeration and Air-conditioning (RAC) equipment by 31.12.2024 and enable the conditions to achieve the phase-out later, as per Stage III agreement with the ExCom of the MLF. The ISP will be critical to enforce the provisions of the ODS (Regulation and control) Rules as amended from time to time, it will (c)coordinate, consult and engage with concerned line ministries/ organisations/bodies/ industry/ industry associations, trade bodies, etc for implementation of the Montreal Protocol and national regulations; allow for (d) Planning and implementation of information outreach activities through active involvement of all stakeholders and (e) coordinate actions for the design of national strategy for phase down of HFCs in close coordination with all concerned stakeholders.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
